profile.headline: Staff Engineer Bringing Production Rigor to AI | Building Reliable Systems & Stronger Communities ✨
profile.summary: Seasoned Software engineer; born in Kiwchwa territory, raised in London and currently living in Ohlone territory. My world view makes me an empathetic listener that brings a calming presence to product engineering team discussions. I’m able to make thoughtful architectural decisions, carefully scope out timelines, and communicate road blocks early on so we can take the right action.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
AI Candidate Evaluation Platform: Architected and delivered a production-grade AI evaluation system, including job description extraction, input sanitization, LLM-based assessment, and deterministic aggregation - replacing a legacy system prone to scalability failures. Extended the platform with a scalable backfill pipeline to score all eligible jobs and candidates platform-wide, with adaptive rate-limiting and resumability to ensure zero impact to real-time operations.

AI Safety & Evaluation Integrity: Led delivery of a multi-phase AI safety and evaluation integrity initiative, including a dedicated review service and fail-closed output gate, ensuring all candidate evaluations meet quality and compliance standards before surfacing to end users.

Technical Leadership & Team Unblocking: Decomposed complex, multi-stream projects into parallel workstreams with clear ownership, detailed cycle docs, and architecture diagrams; enabling teammates to move simultaneously without collisions. Communicated system maturity gaps directly to senior leadership with clear framing of the path forward.

AI Pipeline Reliability: Diagnosed and resolved complex LLM output failures across the AI evaluation pipeline, introducing typed error contracts, structured logging, and correlation fields to improve observability and reduce recurrence.

Cross-Functional Feature Delivery: Led and contributed to multiple high-impact product features earlier in tenure, including a configurable automation engine (team of 6) that drastically reduced manual customer labor, and an analytics product that brought new personas into the platform and drove a 30% increase in overall product usage.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · Software Development · HTML5 · TypeScript · css

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
1. Company Rebrand: Proactively sought out a role reporting into a design team. The team was going through a rebrand and I was the glue to keep our marketing website and application in sync. I contributed to the application design systems while rapidly developing a CSS heavy sales and marketing website.
2. Vue.js Blog: Integrated Vue.js into the CSM sales and marketing website, adding interactive features to the company blog, and doubling marketing leads from blog articles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Productionized MEAN Application: Spearheaded the creation and deployment of a MEAN stack application that enabled seamless communication between Cisco and its acquired companies. The application provided a clear audit trail of sensitive information, reducing risk and enhancing compliance. The successful deployment of this application led to reduced operational costs, and increased efficiency.
2. Ordering System: Contributed to AngularJS application for ordering conference equipment.
3. Python Scripting: Automated network device audit processes by writing python scripts.
